questions.question: दासः + अस्मि — choose the correct sandhi form.
questions.explanation: अः before अ becomes ओऽ.

questions.question: देवः + जयति — choose the correct sandhi form.
questions.explanation: अः before a घोष consonant becomes ओ.

questions.question: सन्तोषः + एव — choose the correct sandhi form.
questions.explanation: अः before a vowel other than अ loses the visarga.

questions.question: भक्ताः + आगच्छन्ति — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: आः before a vowel loses the visarga.

questions.question: मेघाः + वर्षन्ति — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: आः before a घोष consonant loses the visarga.

questions.question: मुनिः + भजते — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: After इ, visarga becomes र् before a घोष consonant.

questions.question: ऋषेः + अगस्त्यस्य — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: After a vowel other than अ/आ, visarga before a vowel becomes र्.

questions.question: हरिः + रक्षति — choose the correct sandhi result.
questions.explanation: Before र्, the inserted र् disappears and the preceding vowel lengthens.

questions.question: सः + अहम् — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: The special सः rule before अ gives ओऽ.

questions.question: एषः + आचार्यः — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: The special एषः rule before a sound other than अ drops the visarga.

questions.question: भोः + अर्जुन! — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: भोः before a vowel loses the visarga.

questions.question: भोः + कृष्ण! — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: भोः before an अघोष consonant retains the visarga.

questions.question: पुनः + अपि — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: र्-स्थानिक विसर्ग restores र् before a vowel.

questions.question: रवेः + छविः — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: Visarga before छ् becomes श्.

questions.question: गङ्गायाः + तीरे — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: Visarga before त् becomes स्.

questions.question: वचन + अमृतम् — choose the correct दीर्घसन्धि form.
questions.explanation: अ + अ becomes आ: वचन + अमृतम् → वचनामृतम्.

questions.question: देव + आलयः — choose the correct sandhi form.
questions.explanation: अ + आ becomes आ: देव + आलयः → देवालयः.

questions.question: मुनि + इन्द्रः — choose the correct sandhi form.
questions.explanation: इ + इ becomes ई: मुनि + इन्द्रः → मुनीन्द्रः.

questions.question: गुरु + उत्साहः — choose the correct sandhi form.
questions.explanation: उ + उ becomes ऊ: गुरु + उत्साहः → गुरूत्साहः.

questions.question: पितृ + ऋणम् — choose the form given in the दीर्घसन्धि lesson.
questions.explanation: ऋ + ऋ becomes ॠ in the chapter’s example पितृ + ऋणम् → पितॄणम्.

questions.question: Which pair of adjoining vowels becomes **ई** in दीर्घसन्धिः?
questions.explanation: The इ / ई family combines into long ई in दीर्घसन्धिः. ()

questions.question: Which pair of adjoining vowels becomes **ऊ** in दीर्घसन्धिः?
questions.explanation: The उ / ऊ family combines into long ऊ. ()

questions.question: Which pair of adjoining vowels becomes **आ** in दीर्घसन्धिः?
questions.explanation: The अ / आ family combines into long आ. ()

questions.question: Which pair of adjoining vowels becomes **ॠ** in दीर्घसन्धिः?
questions.explanation: The ऋ / ॠ family combines into long ॠ. ()

questions.question: वचनामृतम् comes from which pair in Chapter 15?
questions.explanation: The chapter combines वचन + अमृतम् using अ + अ → आ.

questions.question: मुनीन्द्रः comes from which pair in Chapter 15?
questions.explanation: The chapter demonstrates मुनि + इन्द्रः → मुनीन्द्रः (इ + इ → ई).

questions.question: Which transformation is an example of **दीर्घसन्धिः**?
questions.explanation: देव + आलयः combines अ + आ into आ, demonstrating दीर्घसन्धिः; the other pairs illustrate गुणसन्धिः.

questions.question: In मुनि + इन्द्रः → मुनीन्द्रः, which long vowel appears at the junction?
questions.explanation: The adjoining इ + इ forms ई in मुनीन्द्रः.

questions.question: In गुरु + उत्साहः → गुरूत्साहः, which vowel change occurs?
questions.explanation: Two उ vowels combine into long ऊ.

questions.question: Which statement best describes दीर्घसन्धिः as taught in Chapter 15?
options: अ / आ combines with इ / ई to form ए.
अ / आ combines with उ / ऊ to form ओ.
Two vowels of the same family combine into the corresponding long vowel.
questions.explanation: दीर्घसन्धिः combines vowels of the same family into a long vowel; the other vowel-pair descriptions are गुणसन्धि rules.

questions.question: ईश्वर + इच्छा — choose the correct गुणसन्धि form.
questions.explanation: अ + इ becomes ए: ईश्वर + इच्छा → ईश्वरेच्छा.

questions.question: महा + ईशः — choose the correct गुणसन्धि form.
questions.explanation: आ + ई becomes ए: महा + ईशः → महेशः.

questions.question: भाग्य + उदयः — choose the correct गुणसन्धि form.
questions.explanation: अ + उ becomes ओ: भाग्य + उदयः → भाग्योदयः.

questions.question: रेवा + ऊर्मिः — choose the correct गुणसन्धि form.
questions.explanation: आ + ऊ becomes ओ: रेवा + ऊर्मिः → रेवोर्मिः.

questions.question: देव + ऋषिः — choose the correct गुणसन्धि form.
questions.explanation: अ + ऋ becomes अर्: देव + ऋषिः → देवर्षिः.

questions.question: वर्षा + ऋतुः — choose the correct गुणसन्धि form.
questions.explanation: आ + ऋ becomes अर्: वर्षा + ऋतुः → वर्षर्तुः.

questions.question: In गुणसन्धिः, what does **अ / आ + इ / ई** become?
questions.explanation: अ / आ followed by इ / ई produces ए.

questions.question: In गुणसन्धिः, what does **अ / आ + उ / ऊ** become?
questions.explanation: अ / आ followed by उ / ऊ produces ओ.

questions.question: In गुणसन्धिः, what does **अ / आ + ऋ / ॠ** become?
questions.explanation: अ / आ followed by ऋ / ॠ produces अर्.

questions.question: In the गुणसन्धि rule table, what does **अ / आ + लृ** become?
questions.explanation: The chapter names अल् as the गुण result for अ / आ + लृ.

questions.question: महेशः is formed from which pair in Chapter 15?
questions.explanation: महा + ईशः combines आ + ई into ए, forming महेशः.

questions.question: भाग्योदयः illustrates which vowel combination?
questions.explanation: भाग्य ends in inherent अ and उदयः begins with उ: अ + उ → ओ.

questions.question: Which transformation illustrates **गुणसन्धिः**?
questions.explanation: देव + ऋषिः combines अ + ऋ into अर्, a गुणसन्धि rule; the other pairs show दीर्घसन्धिः.

questions.question: Which group lists the four गुण results named in Chapter 15?
questions.explanation: Chapter 15 identifies ए, ओ, अर् and अल् as the गुण results.

questions.question: Which sandhi is used in ईश्वर + इच्छा → ईश्वरेच्छा?
questions.explanation: The अ + इ junction changes to ए, which the chapter teaches as गुणसन्धिः.
